 Sanjay Ayer – Think Different and Get Better at WCM (EP.366) Feb 5, 2024

 Sanjay Ayer is a portfolio manager at WCM Investment Management,
the Laguna-based $80 billion equity manager profiled on three
popular past episodes with CEO Paul Black, President Mike Trigg,
and emerging market portfolio manager Mike Tian. Sanjay joined WCM
in 2007, and alongside Mike Trigg, leads the firm’s research
process that follows the mantra: think different and get
better.

 

Our conversation is a fascinating exploration of the differentiated
mindset at WCM. We discuss topics, including self-discovery,
cognitive dissonance, thinking differently, getting better,
compounding knowledge, reflection time, and feedback loops – all in
the context of Sanjay’s path and the application of the concepts to
WCM’s research process, investment examples, and business.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
